title: In vitro conversion of adult murine endothelial cells to hematopoietic stem cells.
protocol: Generate lentiviral particles of FosB, Gfi1, Runx1, Spi1.
Titer the generated lentivirus.
Anesthetize mice with a mixture of O₂ and Isothesia isoflurane.
Set vaporizer knob to 4 and flow rate to 3 L/min.
Allow 3-5 min until mice are completely anesthetized.
Inject 25 micrograms of anti VE-Cadherin-AF647 antibody retro-orbitally in 8–10 weeks old Runx1-rtTA mice.
Sacrifice mice by CO₂.
Harvest selected organs in ice-cold PBS.
Wash the organs twice in ice-cold PBS.
Incubate organs with Dispase/Collagenase/DNAse mix at 37°C on an orbital shaker (250 rpm) for 20–30 min to create a single cell suspension.
Wash cells twice with mouse EC media.
Wash cells twice with PBS containing 5 mM EDTA and 1% BSA.
Re-suspend cells in PBS containing 5 mM EDTA and 1% BSA, then filter through a 40 μm filter immediately prior to counterstain.
Block single cell suspension with an antibody against CD16/32 for 5 minutes on ice.
Stain single cell suspension with anti-mouse CD31-PE-Cy7, anti-mouse ter119-BV421, and anti-mouse CD45-PE for 30 minutes.
Wash cells twice with PBS containing 5 mM EDTA and 1% BSA.
Re-suspend cells in PBS containing 5 mM EDTA, 1% BSA, and 300 nM DAPI.
Sort adult murine ECs as VEcad+, CD31+, CD45-, ter119-, DAPI- cells using BD SORP FACS ARIA2.
Culture purified adult mouse EC cultures on fibronectin-coated plates in EC growth media in a humidified incubator at 37°C, 5% CO2, and 5% O2.
Isolate primary HUVECs and culture them in EC growth medium.
Transduce primary HUVECs with E4ORF1 gene (serotype 5).
Culture transduced HUVECs in human EC media in a humidified incubator at 37°C, 5% CO2, 5% O2.
Isolate adult mouse Runx1-rtTA ECs and seed them on one well of fibronectin-coated twelve plate with approximately 250,000 to 300,000 cells.
Grow isolated mouse ECs to 90% confluency in mouse EC media.
Expand mouse ECs until they cover six wells of a six-well plate.
Refresh mouse EC media (containing 5 μM SB431542) every 2 days.
Check for CD45+ contaminating cells in Runx1-rtTA ECs by flow cytometry.
Exclude any CD45+ contaminating cells from Runx1-rtTA ECs through an extra sort by flow cytometry before transduction with FGRS.
Expand purified Runx1-rtTA ECs until they cover six wells of a six-well plate in mouse EC media.
Transduce Runx1-rtTA ECs with 10,000 picograms of FosB, Gfi1, Runx1, and Spi1 lentiviral particles per well in the presence of 5 µg of polybrene.
Culture transduced ECs in mouse EC medium for 72 hours.
Induce FGRS with doxycycline at a concentration of 1 µg/ml for 48 hours in mouse EC medium (add doxycycline every 24 hours).
Plate HUVEC-E4ORF1 on a six-well plate and grow to 50% confluency.
Harvest FGRS-transduced Runx1-rtTA ECs using accutase and plate onto a well of 50% confluent HUVEC-E4ORF1 in mouse EC media with doxycycline at 1 µg/ml.
Add doxycycline to the culture medium every 24 hours for 28 days.
Replace conversion media every 48 hours.
Spin down the media in a 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube at 500 g for 5 minutes at 4°C, aspirate the supernatant, feed with 1 ml of fresh conversion media, and add back to the well.
Lethally irradiate CD45.1+ congenic recipients with 900 cGy using 137Cs gamma irradiation.
Maintain transplanted recipient under sulfatrim for the first two weeks following transplantation.
Harvest rEC-HSPC and HUVEC-E4ORF1 using accutase on day 28 of conversion.
Wash single cell suspension twice with PBS 5mM EDTA 1%BSA.
Block single cell suspension with an antibody against CD16/32 for 5 minutes on ice.
Stain single cell with anti-human CD31-BV421, anti-mouse VECad-A647, anti-mouse CD31-PE Cy7 and anti-mouse CD45-PE.
Wash cells twice with 5mM EDTA 1%BSA.
Re-suspend cells in 5mM EDTA 1%BSA 300nM DAPI.
Exclude HUVEC-E4ORF1 feeder cells via hCD31 gating.
Define and sort rEC-HSPCs as VEcad<sup>-</sup>mCD31<sup>-</sup>Runx1-GFP<sup>+</sup>CD45<sup>+</sup>DAPI<sup>-</sup>.
Interrogate all cells by examining FSC-H and FSC-W to discern single cells.
Ensure only rEC-HSPCs are collected without HUVEC-E4ORF1 feeder cells by comparing SSC-H to SSC-W.
Sort 800,000 VEcad<sup>-</sup>mCD31<sup>-</sup>Runx1-GFP<sup>+</sup>CD45<sup>+</sup>DAPI<sup>-</sup> rEC-HSPCs per CD45.1 recipient.
Inject 800,000 VEcad<sup>-</sup>mCD31<sup>-</sup>Runx1-GFP<sup>+</sup>CD45<sup>+</sup>DAPI<sup>-</sup> cells retro-orbitally into lethally irradiated CD45.1<sup>+</sup> recipients.
Maintain transplanted mice with moistened food and Sulfatrim for 7 days after transplant.
Continue to maintain transplanted recipient under sulfatrim for the first two weeks following transplantation.
Determine multi-lineage engraftment every 4 weeks by flow cytometry of peripheral blood using DAPI to discriminate dead cells.
Proceed to secondary transplantation after 20 weeks.
Isolate whole bone marrow from primary engrafted mice.
Transplant the isolated bone marrow retro-orbitally into lethally irradiated CD45.1+ recipients.
Determine multi-lineage engraftment every 4 weeks for 20 weeks by flow cytometry of peripheral blood.
Collect blood in a heparinized tube.
Transfer collected blood to a tube containing 500 μl PBS with EDTA.
Proceed to red blood cell (RBC) lysis.
Discard the supernatant after RBC lysis.
Resuspend the cells in PBS containing 5 mM EDTA and 1% BSA at a concentration of 2 x 10^6 cells per mL.
Proceed to cell staining using the specified antibody panels.
Sacrifice endpoint transplanted mice by CO2 suffocation.
Harvest spleens in ice-cold PBS.
Slice the excised spleen into small pieces.
Place the fragments onto a 40 µm strainer attached to a 50-mL conical tube.
Press the excised spleen through the strainer using the plunger end of a syringe.
Wash the cells through the strainer with ice-cold PBS.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 500g for 5 minutes.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Proceed to RBC Lysis.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in PBS 5mM EDTA 1%BSA at a concentration of 2 x 10^6 cells per mL.
Proceed to cell staining using the T/B cocktail or T/Effector/Memory/GD antibody panels as specified.
Sacrifice endpoint transplanted mice by CO2 suffocation.
Harvest spleens in ice cold PBS.
Isolate whole bone marrow from femurs by mechanically removing all muscle and connective tissue.
Crush the isolated bone marrow in a sterile mortar and pestle.
Digest the crushed bone marrow with 2.5 mg/ml Collagenase A and 1 unit/ml Dispase II in Hank’s balanced salt solution at 37°C for 30 min with gentle agitation.
Filter the resulting cell suspension through a 0.45 μm cell strainer to obtain a single-cell suspension.
Quantify haematopoietic stem cells by flow cytometry using the following antibody combination:
Label cells with Lineage cocktail conjugated to BV421/Pac Blue.
Label cells with Runx1 reporter conjugated to GFP.
Label cells with Sca1 conjugated to PE.
Label cells with CD150 conjugated to PE-Cy7.
Label cells with c-kit conjugated to APC.
Label cells with CD48 conjugated to AF700.
Label cells with a marker specific for haematopoietic stem cells conjugated to APC-Cy7.
